_comment: Deterministic reasoning template for D4b (Few-Shot CoT). Rules apply per dataset over the non-protected features of the row sampled from df_train. The reasoning is generated as a sequence of Steps that describe each feature's implication, followed by a Conclusion that declares the label. Protected attributes (sex, race, age in German Credit) are never referenced. Missing/unrecognised values fall back to neutral default clauses.

top.clause: {value} corresponds to a graduate or professional degree, associated with top earners

college.clause: {value} corresponds to college-level education, associated with above-median income

some_college.clause: {value} indicates some post-secondary education without a full degree, limiting access to high-paying roles

hs.clause: {value} indicates high-school graduate level, associated with moderate-to-lower income

below_hs.clause: {value} indicates below high-school level, strongly associated with lower income

education.default_clause: education level is not reported in a recognised category

manual.clause: {value} is typically lower-paid manual or service work

occupation.default_clause: occupation not reported in a recognised category

ranges.clause: {value} hours/week is well below full-time, suggesting limited income
{value} hours/week is below the standard full-time schedule
{value} hours/week is a standard full-time schedule
{value} hours/week is above standard full-time, indicating extra commitment
{value} hours/week is well above standard, indicating high professional engagement

capital_activity.default_clause: no capital activity could be assessed from this record

capital_activity_logic._comment: Composite reasoning. Order matters: first matching condition fires.

conditions.clause: capital gain of {capital-gain} is substantial, a marker of high-income financial activity
modest capital gain of {capital-gain} is reported
capital loss of {capital-loss} is reported, indicating taxable investment activity
no investment activity reported (no capital gain or loss)

adult.conclusion_template: Step {n} — Conclusion: based on education, occupation, hours, and capital activity above, the answer is {label}.

less serious misdemeanor offence

ProPublica risk score is reported as Low

age {value}, in the elevated-risk range for recidivism
age {value}, in the moderate age range

age {value}, well past peak recidivism risk

compas.conclusion_template: Step {n} — Conclusion: based on prior record, charge severity, ProPublica risk score, and age, the answer is {label}.
